skip: Brand-mark archive ('Logobook - Discover the worlds finest logos, symbols and trademarks'), a reference library rather than a component/example site: /logo/<name>/ (7354) is one trademark record, /designer/<name>/ (2043), /design-company/<name>/ (723), /business/<name>/ (2351), /object/<name>/ (544), /nature/<name>/ (292), /shape/<name>/ (169) are designer/company/category indexes. Individual logos are neither UI components nor UI examples (the taxonomy's logo-cloud element means a logo-wall section, not one brand mark), so nothing here should become a catalog item.
